cases.prompt:
Perform an offline supply-chain review of the following exact proposed change. Do not install, resolve, update, execute, quarantine, remove, or approve anything.

Boundary: repository root `/repo`, owning build root `/repo`, baseline commit `4f8a2c1`, proposed change `pr-184.patch`. Intended change: add `widget-kit` for build-time asset generation, add a postinstall bootstrap, and add a third-party setup action. Files in scope are `package.json`, `package-lock.json`, `scripts/bootstrap.js`, and `.github/workflows/build.yml` only.

Repository policy `SEC-12`: npm dependencies must resolve through `https://registry.npmjs.org/` unless a security exception is recorded; new lifecycle scripts require Security approval; third-party GitHub Actions must use a full 40-hex-character commit reference. No exception or approval record is supplied.

Diff:
`package.json`
`+ "postinstall": "node scripts/bootstrap.js"`
`+ "widget-kit": "https://downloads.widgets.example/widget-kit-2.1.0.tgz"`

`package-lock.json`
`+ "node_modules/widget-kit": {"version":"2.1.0","resolved":"https://downloads.widgets.example/widget-kit-2.1.0.tgz","integrity":"sha512-QUJDREVESURBVEE="}`

`scripts/bootstrap.js`
`+ const {execFileSync}=require('node:child_process');`
`+ execFileSync('./node_modules/.bin/widget-build',['--output','dist/assets'],{stdio:'inherit'});`

`.github/workflows/build.yml`
` jobs.build.steps:`
`+ - uses: thirdparty/setup-widget@v2`
`+ - run: npm ci`
`+ - run: npm run build`

Bounded collector output for those four files:
`{"files":[{"path":"package.json","lifecycleScripts":["postinstall"],"uncommonDependencySources":[{"name":"widget-kit","type":"remote-tarball"}]},{"path":"package-lock.json","lockEntries":[{"name":"widget-kit","resolved":"https://downloads.widgets.example/widget-kit-2.1.0.tgz","integrityPresent":true}]},{"path":"scripts/bootstrap.js","recognized":false},{"path":".github/workflows/build.yml","actions":[{"uses":"thirdparty/setup-widget@v2","referenceType":"named-ref"}]}],"truncated":false}`

Review only this supplied boundary. Separate observed state, risk inference, and externally unverifiable claims. For every supported finding include severity, exact path and location, observed evidence, affected installation or build boundary, plausible failure path, confidence, and the smallest evidence-producing next check. Do not infer that the package or action is malicious, that the integrity value was verified, or that the named action reference is trustworthy. Return all required headings in order and leave merge acceptance to the authorized reviewer.
sourceAnchors: Compare manifest intent with the lockfile diff

requiredEvidence: path-qualified signals for the remote tarball, postinstall surface, executable bootstrap boundary, and named GitHub Action reference
each actionable finding is tied to the explicit `SEC-12` policy and includes a plausible installation or build failure path
severity, location, observed evidence, affected boundary, confidence, and smallest next check accompany every finding
unverified package identity, integrity validity, action trust, and approval status remain explicitly unverified
